pins.head: THE DESK FACES THE WINDOW
pins.sub: A Working Corner, Not a Room
pins.title: Studio Layout: Carve a Working Corner Out of One Room
pins.desc: A desk pushed against the wall beside the bed makes the whole studio feel like a bedroom you happen to work in. Turn it to face the window instead and the corner reads as its own zone, because what your eye follows when you sit down is what decides the room. Contains affiliate links. #StudioApartment #WorkFromHome #SmallSpaceLiving
pins.alt: A wooden desk and chair set against a large window on the far side of a studio, with a teal sofa and a round rug in the middle of the room.

pins.head: COUNT ONLY THE ONES YOU USE
pins.title: Acne Patches: Count Only the Sizes You Actually Use
pins.desc: Mixed-size sheets look generous and then half of them sit unused because they are too big for anything you get. Work out which sizes you actually reach for, count how many of those a sheet gives you, and divide the price by that number rather than by the total count. Contains affiliate links. #SkincareBasics #AcnePatches #BathroomCounter
pins.alt: Two sheets of round clear hydrocolloid patches in several sizes lying on a white bathroom counter above a light wood drawer.

pins.head: A SLIM CART ROLLS ASIDE
pins.title: Small Bathroom: A Narrow Rolling Cart Needs No Wall
pins.desc: The gap beside a vanity is usually six to eight inches, which is about the width of a slim rolling cart. It takes the clutter off the counter, rolls out when you need the back of it, and leaves the wall untouched for the day you move. Measure the gap before you order. Contains affiliate links. #BathroomStorage #RollingCart #RenterFriendly
pins.alt: A narrow white rolling cart standing beside a wooden vanity in a small bathroom, with a shelf unit of towels, jars and baskets over the toilet.

pins.head: COUNT DECALS, NOT FEET
pins.title: Vinyl Roll Yield: Count Decals Instead of Feet
pins.desc: Twenty feet of vinyl sounds like plenty until you lay the design out and find the waste between shapes eats a third of it. Nest your cuts on the mat first, count how many fit across a twelve-inch width, then divide the roll by that. Buy by decals, not by length. Contains affiliate links. #VinylCrafts #CricutProjects #CraftPlanning
pins.alt: Two rolls of adhesive vinyl in sage and cream lying on a wooden worktable beside a gridded cutting mat with a calculator and a pencil.

pins.head: HEAT POPS WHAT STIRRING MADE
pins.title: Mini Heat Gun for Clearing Bubbles From a Resin Pour
pins.desc: Stirring puts the bubbles in and waiting will not get them all out. A short pass with a mini heat gun on the low setting brings them to the surface and pops them before the resin thickens. Keep it moving and keep it high, because held still it dents the surface instead. Contains affiliate links. #ResinArt #EpoxyResin #ResinTips
pins.alt: A hand stirring resin in a clear cup with a wooden stick on a black silicone mat, with the nozzle of a small heat gun resting beside it.

pins.head: RAISE THE SCREEN, DROP THE BOX
pins.title: Home Office: A Monitor Riser Turns One Desk Into Two Levels
pins.desc: A small desk runs out of surface long before it runs out of jobs. Lifting the screen puts the keyboard, the notebook and the charger underneath it instead of beside it, and a floor basket takes whatever still does not fit. Check the riser is wider than the laptop feet. Contains affiliate links. #HomeOffice #DeskSetup #SmallSpaceLiving
pins.alt: A laptop raised on a wooden riser at a desk by a window, with a file sorter beside it, a woven basket on the floor underneath and a teal chair pulled up.

pins.head: MIX IT, DO NOT BUY IT
pins.title: Acrylic Starter Palette: Five Tubes Cover Almost Everything
pins.desc: A twenty-four colour set teaches you to hunt for a colour instead of mixing it. Red, yellow and blue plus black and white will reach nearly any shade you need, and mixing them is what trains your eye. Add a sixth tube only when you keep missing the same colour. Contains affiliate links. #AcrylicPainting #ColorMixing #PaintingForBeginners
pins.alt: Five paint tubes with red, yellow, blue, black and white caps standing behind a white palette holding dabs of paint, beside two brushes on a wooden table.

pins.head: A HANGING SHELF ADDS A TIER
pins.sub: Fold Where You Used to Hang
pins.title: Tiny Closet: Add a Folding Tier Without Touching the Wall
pins.desc: Half a closet's hanging space goes on things that fold better than they hang. A fabric organizer hooked over the rail turns that stretch into four shelves for sweaters and jeans, and it comes down in a second when the lease ends. Leave the rail end free for coats. Contains affiliate links. #ClosetOrganization #RenterFriendly #SmallCloset
pins.alt: A closet with clothes on a two-tier rail, woven baskets on the top shelf, a fabric hanging shelf organizer holding folded knits at the right and clear shoe boxes along the floor.

pins.head: COUNT THE SERVINGS, NOT GRAMS
pins.title: Protein Powder: Price the Tub by Servings, Not by Weight
pins.desc: Two tubs of the same weight can hold very different numbers of servings, because the scoop size changes with the formula. Read servings per container on the back, divide the price by that, and you will often find the bigger tub is the dearer one per shake. Contains affiliate links. #ProteinPowder #GroceryBudget #KitchenStaples
pins.alt: A clear shaker bottle with a mixing ball standing beside a large tub of protein powder and a folded towel on a wooden counter.

pins.head: LEAN, TENSION OR HANG
pins.title: Renter Storage: Lean It, Tension It or Hang It on a Door
pins.desc: Every no-drill fix is one of three things: something that leans against the wall, something that wedges between two surfaces, or something that hooks over a door. Pick by what the wall will take rather than by what looks best, and keep the heavy items on the leaning piece. Contains affiliate links. #RenterFriendly #NoDrilling #StorageIdeas
pins.alt: A ladder shelf holding small plants at the left and an over-the-door pocket organizer at the right of a living room, with a cushioned sofa and an ottoman between them.

pins.head: SIZE THE SHEET, NOT THE ROLL
pins.title: Quick-Size Paper Towels: Eight Family Rolls for the Closet
pins.desc: Roll counts are marketing; sheet counts are the number that matters. A family roll holds roughly twice an ordinary one, so eight of them replace a sixteen-pack and take up half the shelf. Tear-off size counts too, because smaller sheets mean you use one instead of three. Contains affiliate links. #HouseholdEssentials #PaperGoods #StockUp
pins.alt: White paper rolls stacked on a closet shelf above neatly folded white towels, with a small clip-on label at the shelf edge.

pins.head: THE PIPE DECIDES THE SHELF
pins.title: Under-Sink Shelves: Let the Pipe Decide the Size
pins.desc: The usable space under a sink is not the cabinet, it is whatever the drain pipe leaves behind. Measure the clear width on each side of the pipe and the height under the trap, then buy a shelf that fits the smaller side. An expandable frame covers the rest. Contains affiliate links. #KitchenOrganization #UnderSinkStorage #SmallKitchen
pins.alt: An open under-sink cabinet with white drain pipes and a yellow tape measure stretched across the cabinet floor beside a pale green two-tier shelf.
